loop.loop_direction: clockwise seen from the ground station
loop.frames: world = diag(1,-1,-1) Makani g; body = diag(-1,1,-1) Makani body; sideslip sign reversed in the body axes

rotors.rule: constant speed; 97.4 rad/s is the maximum-shaft-power speed of the table at the loop-mean commanded airspeed 46.5 m/s

settings.scope: wing and tail aerodynamic loads of each unit and its tether force and the eight rotor discs of each unit; no pylons, fuselage, hand-over or wind shear

aerodynamics.spatial_field_contract: Uniform (3,) or callable(points_m, time_s); lattice methods require callable for nonuniform fields
aerodynamics.stage_bound_interpolation: linear_endpoint_geometry; exact for translation, approximate for rotation
aerodynamics.convection_order_scope: Frozen circulation/core geometry ODE only; not coupled time order
aerodynamics.closure: VSM 3/4-chord closure with material finite free wake; 1/4-chord trailing-only load direction
aerodynamics.far_wake: opt-in, outside the contract named here: rows older than free_convection_rows are convected with the local ambient velocity only; they keep their circulation (docs/tasks/OF-0006-accel20261001/README.zh.md)
aerodynamics.method_origin: OpenFAWE combination; not an upstream KiteFAST free-wake implementation
aerodynamics.load_point_ambient_sampling: Spatial callables sampled separately at quarter chord; legacy panel arrays reused as supplied
